description: Per-server, per-agent rate limits for MCP tool calls through the APIM AI gateway. Single source of truth; compiled into one APIM policy PER MCP server by infra/modules/model-gateway/apim-mcp-compliance.bicep (applied during 'azd up' and re-applied on demand by the deploy-compliancy workflow). Keyed by MCP server 'name' (matching mcp/mcp.json) so each server has its own independent allowlist. Within a server, each agent is keyed by the AppId carried in its AgenticIdentityToken (the instance_identity.client_id from the Foundry agent definition; discover with scripts/list-agent-appids.ps1) and gets its own requestsPerMinute. DENY-BY-DEFAULT and PER-SERVER: on a given server, any AppId not listed under that server (or a server with no entry here at all) is rejected with HTTP 403 -- an agent allowed on one server is NOT implicitly allowed on another.
